svg.title: Apron Architecture Overview
svg.desc: 10,000-foot view of the Apron monorepo: UI layer, server, agents, integrations, and data stores.
svg.text: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS · no build step · no framework
Express-free raw node:http · ws library · no build step
EVENT FLOW — HOW DATA MOVES AT RUNTIME
SPOTTER / TRAFFIC / CUSTOMS → ADVANCE / STEWARD / WRANGLER → FIXER → ⊘ HUMAN GATE → RUNNER
readers observe the world state agents track constraints actors generate options approval required desk handoff
● REAL: orchestrator, bus, credentials, provenance, rules engine, audit pipeline, Firestore, server, board, WebSocket
● WIRED BUT UNUSED: GeminiClient (instantiated, never called by agents), credential check() enforcement
● STUB: all 8 agents are fixture-replay shims — SPOTTER is the first to go live
